reasons.requirements: All seven acceptance criteria are covered in the spec and the diff, and the spec adds precise edge-case contracts: atomic updates, UTC handling, and filter validation.
reasons.scope: The change stays on the feature, but it adds a .worktrees/ entry to .gitignore, stale-response and error handling that the ticket did not ask for, and extensive plan and spec docs.
reasons.tests: Store, HTTP and page tests cover the new behaviour thoroughly, including leap years, UTC midnight, atomic rejection, filter validation and stale responses; the only existing assertions touched were extended, none weakened or removed.
reasons.conventions: The change keeps to zero dependencies, uses ValidationError mapped to 400, follows TDD, and adds data-testid attributes to every new element as AGENTS.md asks.
reasons.architecture: Validation and the overdue projection live in the store, the filter parameter is validated in app.mjs, and the page reuses the API's overdue value without computing its own.
reasons.codeQuality: The code is correct and compact, but the date validator has a redundant length check and an awkward invalid() closure, and the page test harness is somewhat heavy.
